node.statement: Choose the universal threshold e_u no larger than every threshold used above and 1/[2(1+C_pr)]. Then 1-(1+C_pr)e >= 1/2, so t <= 2(1+C_co*e_u)=:K_u, uniformly in n. This proves the amended node without invoking node 1.1.1.1 or an unregistered diagonal-amplification isometry.
